descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a randomized, open-label, multi-center phase II trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of the becotatug vedotin in combination with pucotenlimab regimen in patients with advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma who are intolerant to platinum-based therapy.
